items.Sentence: The gravity collection system is designed to convey wastewater to a 19,200-gallon septic tank battery, which is comprised of twelve 1,600-gallon septic tanks arranged in three parallel trains. The tanks are designed to provide treatment prior to gravity flow to eight hundred linear feet of leach lines situated on an approximately 15-degree sloping hillside.

The septic tanks are pumped annually. In 2016, a total of 15,000 gallons of septage was removed. The septage is hauled to the District's Deer Creek Wastewater Treatment Plant, which is regulated under National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) Order R5-2014-0081.
